steps.note: Open the Events list to locate the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab as required by the case.
Open the draft's Participants view and the All Vendors window.
Confirm the All Vendors window opened.
Select the specified vendor checkbox before cancelling.
Cancel the All Vendors window without saving the selection.
Verify that the All Vendors window closed after Cancel.
